latHint: Think a TV talent show panel.
pivHint: Fear the LORD and shun evil, Solomon writes. In British courtrooms, a ______ is formally addressed as 'My Lord.'
winText: You found it. LORD isn't just who Solomon says to fear — in British courtrooms, a JUDGE is formally addressed as 'My Lord.'
lossText: The word was JUDGE. LORD was the pivot — in British courtrooms, a JUDGE is addressed as 'My Lord.' JUDGE is also the title for a panelist scoring contestants on TV talent shows.
votdVerse: Do not be wise in your own eyes; fear the Lord and shun evil.
passageText: Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding; in all your ways submit to him, and he will make your paths straight. Do not be wise in your own eyes; fear the Lord and shun evil. This will bring health to your body and nourishment to your bones.
